sources.version: CSS Font Loading Module Level 3 Working Draft
sources.notes: Defines FontFace from ArrayBuffer and FontFaceSet behavior for local browser testing.

assumptions: The current browser can parse the selected font and supports FontFace from binary data.
licensing_data_restrictions: No user content is transmitted by normal tool execution. Third-party libraries retain their upstream licenses; font/PDF licensing remains the user’s responsibility.
uncertainty: A successful load proves browser parse/render support in this browser only; it does not validate licensing, all glyphs, or other browsers.
